tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: List of Items supplies along with Users certificate:- List of Items supplied to various Government/Quasi Government/Govt. Autonomous Institutions and similar reputed institutions in Karnataka and India with item specification, quantities and value of the sale during the financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 and as per the Section-XIII and Users certificates as per Section-XV of the Tenderer is to be uploaded in original, If Tenderer is a Manufacturer and If Tenderer is a Principle Authorized Agent/Authorized Distributor should upload his Performance with User Certificates along with his Manufacturers Performance as above mentioned. The User Certificates must be countersigned by the authorized signatory of the Institutions, which have purchased

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: GST Registration Certificate: GST Registration Certificate of the Tenderer in original is to be uploaded
PAN Card PAN Card of the Firm/Tenderer is to be uploaded in original

Manufacturers Authorization Certificate Authorization Certificate from original Manufacturer is to be uploaded in original from reputed Manufacturers, if Tenderer is an Principle Authorized Agent/Distributor and Licensed Authorized Importer as per Section-XIV. The Sub-Agents/Sub-Distributors are not eligible.
Tender Offer Form-Part I Tender Offer Form with an undertaking to abide by the terms and conditions of the tender in the format as per Section-IX-Part-I, of the Tenderer is to be uploaded in original

Declaration From-Part II Declaration from the Tenderer in the format as per Section IX-Part-II of the Tenderer is to be uploaded in original. On on a Rs.200/- stamp paper: by the authorized signatory undertaking that 1) They agree to abide by the conditions of the tender. 2) The firm is not blacklisted by the Government of any State in India or Government of India. 3 The Tenderer undertakes to extend warranty and free service as per the tender conditions

List of Equipments quoted under this Tender List of Equipments along with Manufacturer/s Name, Country of origin and Model name and number quoted by the tenderer should be clearly furnished separately as per Section-XIX, is to be uploaded in original

Technical specifications information Literature & Brochure of the Equipment/s The Technical specifications information complete Literature & Brochure of the Equipment/s quoted by the Tenderer should be uploaded in original
ISO:9001, CE, EC, FDA & CDSCO Certificates etc Standards of quality control Certificates of ISO: 9001, CE, EC, FDA & CDSCO Certificates must be uploaded in original

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Proof of Service Centre/s in Karnataka & Technical Staff available Service Centre/s in Karnataka with Address and Contact No & Technical Staff available for the Equipments as per the Section-XVIII & Proof of Service Centre/s in Karnataka & Technical Staff available & Under taking from manufacturer for providing service for the equipment during warranty & CMC quoted under this Tender should be uploaded in original and service shall be provided within 72 hrs from the receipt of the complaint.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: EMD : Details of Earnest Money Deposited as per KPPP Portal.
GST Returns for the last six months to be uploaded in original

Annual Turn-Over Statement Annual Turnover Must be Three Crore statement for proceeding three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 i.e., for 31-03-2024, 31-03-2025 & 31.03.2026 of the Tenderer as per Section-XVII, Certified by Commercial Tax Officer/Charted Accountant is to be uploaded in original with UDIN No

ITR RETURNS:-Income Tax Returns ITR for the last Three Financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 with Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss account statement in original should be uploaded duly certified by the -Chartered Accountant
